originality.rationale: The exact fixed-sum, fixed-squared-difference envelope for a three-periodic Hilbert weighted shift and its sharp linear-in-variance correction are different from known periodic-shift Rayleigh reductions, general arithmetic-mean bounds, strict convexity, and isolated-edge numerical-radius formulas. Complete source comparisons where available and explicit searches did not reveal the constrained phase transition; indirect earlier equivalences remain possible.
